model.name: a-ladder-of-round-milliseconds
model.of: the byte at a delay-time address, and the time the copy comes back at
model.chosen_by: the range the page prints against that address

what: A ladder of round decimal milliseconds whose step changes a handful of times over the byte. Between two changes the step is constant, so the byte is walked one entry at a time and not solved.
note: Generated from the candidate this file names, and read only by src/soundings/reproduce.py. It states what the candidate predicts at every setting of the byte, so that a reading can disagree with it. Nothing here is a measurement.

how_each_range_was_arrived_at.0 - 500m: Read at all hundred and twenty-eight settings on 01 50, and at seven of them on 01 51, which agreed at every one. The step changes five times: a tenth of a millisecond to fifty, then a half, then one, then ten, then twenty to setting a hundred and twenty-six, where the printed end is reached and the last setting repeats it.
how_each_range_was_arrived_at.0 - 100m: Read at all hundred and twenty-eight settings on 01 40. It shares the longer range's first two steps exactly -- a tenth of a millisecond to setting fifty, then a half to sixty -- and its third step is the same size and runs further: one millisecond to setting a hundred rather than to ninety. Then two milliseconds to setting a hundred and twenty-five, where the printed end is reached and the last two settings repeat it.
how_each_range_was_arrived_at.200m - 990m/1sec: Read at all hundred and twenty-eight settings on 01 52. The only range in this class whose page prints a time at the bottom as well as the top, and the byte starts there: setting zero is two hundred milliseconds, not nothing. Five milliseconds a setting to setting seventy, then ten to setting a hundred and fifteen, where the printed end is reached at one second and the last twelve settings repeat it. Every entry on this range is already a whole step of the clock, so nothing here tells the cut from the uncut ladder and this range is no evidence about the clock.
